title: Type confusion from incomplete PostgreSQL type-cache invalidation allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code…
description: A type confusion vulnerability in PostgreSQL version 18 prior to 18.7 allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database. The flaw arises from incomplete invalidation of the PostgreSQL type-cache during composite type changes while the cache entry is being populated. Versions before PostgreSQL 18 are not affected.
